work.description: CCLXV Dum in dirigenda: entire eight-clause Latin Fattori legacy brief, whole Thomas Fattori/Mondavio testament history and500scudi revenue, all four chaplains’ offices, masses, rural rotation, vestments and stipends; two seminary places, two dowries, anniversary, alms, infirm/orphan and administrative allocations; every Francesco/wife/Paolo/Josepho Gasparelli payment and condition; executor faculties, validation, derogation, accounts, caution and residual-use provisions; sanctio and full datum LF51610–51613. Exact XML leaves390–392 ordinary substantive L/R. Source OCR word losses remain uncorrected; no historical omission invented. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
